bio: Lindsay James (née Beals, born 1980) is an American politician and Presbyterian minister who is the U.S. representative-elect for Iowa's 2nd congressional district. A member of the Democratic Party, she also is serving as a member of the Iowa House of Representatives from the 71st district since 2019, representing part of Dubuque County and serving as House minority whip.
